subject: Banking
title: Can Neobanks Survive?
description: Learn Can Neobanks Survive? in one minute.

hook.text: Most neobanks are not profitable. High marketing costs mean customer acquisition spending exceeds lifetime value.

buildup.text: Chime and Revolut won users with slick apps, but thin fees rarely cover acquisition and service costs.

discovery.text: Traditional banks fight back with better apps. JPMorgan's app now rivals neobank features with full banking.

twist.text: Many neobanks survive by becoming banks. Chime, SoFi, and Revolut are all seeking or have obtained banking charters.

climax.text: Neobanks disrupted the interface but must become banks to survive. The revolution leads right back to banking licenses.

punchline.text: Disrupted banks. Now becoming banks. The revolution comes full circle.

quiz.question: What is the main profitability challenge for neobanks?
options: High customer acquisition costs exceed revenue from no-fee models
